summary: Held out. A periodic metrics flush added to a server survives close(), so every test passes but the test process never exits.
prompt: Add periodic metrics flushing to `startServer` in src/server.js: accept `flushIntervalMs` (default 5000) and call `onFlush` with a snapshot of the metrics every interval while the server runs. The test in test/server.test.js describes the behavior. Make the test suite pass.
